vocabulary.at_computer: sitting at a monitor, hands on keyboard or mouse
vocabulary.on_phone_call: phone held to the ear, in a call
vocabulary.using_phone: phone in hand in front of them, looking at its screen
vocabulary.eating: food or a plate in front of them, bringing food to the mouth
vocabulary.cooking: at the stove or the kitchen counter, preparing food
vocabulary.reading: a book, magazine or papers in hand, looking at them
vocabulary.watching_tv: sitting or lying, facing a TV that is on
vocabulary.playing: playing with toys, a board game or with other people
vocabulary.resting: lying on the sofa or an armchair, awake, doing nothing else
vocabulary.at_car: next to a car: getting in or out, opening the trunk, loading, plugging in the charging cable
vocabulary.other: a clearly visible activity that is not in this list
vocabulary.uncertain: the person is barely visible, from behind or covered: what they are doing cannot be told

attributes.person_visible: a person is clearly visible, and so is what they are doing with their hands
attributes.phone_at_ear: holds a phone close to the ear
attributes.looking_at_phone: is looking at the phone in their hand
attributes.hands_on_keyboard_or_mouse: both hands are on a keyboard or a mouse
attributes.facing_monitor: sits in front of a monitor, facing the screen
attributes.lying_down: is lying on a sofa, an armchair or elsewhere
attributes.facing_tv: sits or lies on a sofa or an armchair, facing the TV
attributes.reading_paper: holds a book, a magazine or papers and looks at them
attributes.at_table_with_food: sits at a table with plates or food in front of them
attributes.at_stove: stands at the stove or the kitchen counter, hands busy
attributes.playing_games: plays with toys, a board game or with other people
attributes.near_car: is next to a car and using it: getting in or out, opening the trunk, loading or unloading, plugging in the charging cable
